name: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp.
description: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp. is a royalty and streaming company focused on precious metals assets across Nevada's highest-grade historical mining districts. The company operates a three-part model: royalty creation and acquisition, precious-metals streaming, and an exploration project accelerator. Key assets include a 3% NSR royalty and exploration stream on the Lapon Canyon Project, plus interests in the Swales and Agai-Pah properties, all within Nevada.
